obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, full-bleed dark background

carbon.$description: Carbon — Deepest surface level, hero band, and overlay backgrounds

chalk.$description: Chalk — Primary text, headings, and body copy on dark surfaces

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary muted text, captions, helper labels

ash.$description: Ash — Mid-weight borders, subtle dividers, tertiary text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary 1px border color for cards, grids, and section dividers — the structural line work

iron.$description: Iron — Secondary border and stroke detail

signal-white.$description: Signal White — Filled pill buttons (LET'S CHAT, START NOW), inverted text on light surfaces, icon strokes — the single high-contrast action color

compass-gold.$description: Compass Gold — Outlined icon strokes in service and portfolio sections — warm metallic against the cool dark

card-slate.$description: Card Slate — Card and panel border accent on elevated sections

aeonik.$description: Primary typeface for everything — display headlines, body, buttons, links. Weight 400 across all sizes is signature: no bold shouting, authority through scale and tracking alone.

input.$description: Secondary typeface for meta text, labels, and small captions. Tighter tracking (-0.037em at 8px, -0.022em at 18px) gives it a utilitarian, almost monospace feel — used for status pills, section metadata, and fine print.
